title: Illustrative unit economics and SaaS workload model
status: Reproducible scenario arithmetic; not a demand forecast, quote, tax determination, or permission to spend.

jurisdiction_assumptions.physical: UK-established seller, UK customers, UK fulfilment, adult apparel/ordinary goods, domestic standard card, no VAT registration for the base case; all unconfirmed.
jurisdiction_assumptions.saas: UK-established SaaS seller selling UK standard-rated digital service to UK customers; registered VAT case shown for comparability; all unconfirmed.
jurisdiction_assumptions.tax_scope: Profit taxes, income tax, corporation tax, National Insurance, duties, foreign sales, and owner drawings excluded. Adult clothing and modeled SaaS treated at standard 20% VAT when registered. Seek qualified advice for actual setup.

assumptions.price_status: Chosen test prices, all-in consumer amounts including standard delivery; willingness to pay untested. No separately added delivery receipt.
assumptions.refund_treatment: Expected full refund returns all checkout receipts, including delivery. Original payment processing charge is retained. No returned stock salvage, supplier reimbursement, replacement refund, or customer-paid/merchant-paid return postage is modeled. Replacement probability adds another full fulfilment cost. Scenario rates, not observed rates.
assumptions.payment_fee_model: Shopify Basic standard online card: 2% of full order amount + £0.25. Fee incurred on the original charge in each order, including refunded orders. Verify actual provider/mix before use; do not stack Stripe and Shopify fees.
assumptions.fixed_cash_note: Inherited illustrative POD proof envelope: samples £120 + three months of shop allowance £90 + domain £15 + three delivered Freestyler gifts £72.24. Float and contingency excluded; replace with actual planned spend.
assumptions.founder_fixed_hours_note: Illustrative 60 setup hours plus four hours/week for 12 weeks; entirely an opportunity-cost scenario.
assumptions.creator_affiliate_basis: Proposed 10% commission is paid only on a non-refunded retained order, using delivered checkout price less the assumed £3.95 delivery allowance. The per-retained-order commission is not the expected fee per initial order; multiply it by (1 - refund rate) for initial-order contribution arithmetic.
assumptions.gifted_tee_attribution_note: Arithmetic-only example; no conversion or attribution evidence.
assumptions.alternative_functional_product: Stanley/Stella heavy tote: choose a practical carrying product with a published 300gsm £11.13 decorated catalogue entry, modeled £30 delivered. This product and price are a test hypothesis, not validated demand.
assumptions.saas_fixed_cost_note: Chosen planning allowance, not a quote. Actual cloud/database/monitoring/support stack, tax on vendor invoices and usage overages are unknown.
assumptions.saas_fx_note: Chosen simplification, not a verified exchange rate; API spend is small here but must use settlement-date FX and any card FX charge in real operation.
assumptions.saas_openai_usage: Representative text-only model scenario at posted GPT-5.6 Luna rates, with no tools, images, retries, caching, safety/model review or prompt-size growth. Free and paid users receive the same monthly token allowance. Model choice may not suit output quality.
assumptions.saas_payment_model: Stripe standard UK card 1.5% + £0.20 per £49 renewal plus Stripe Billing pay-as-you-go fee of 0.7% of £49 billing volume. Failed-payment recovery, refunds, chargebacks, non-UK cards and foreign exchange excluded.
assumptions.saas_founder_admin_sales_product_develop: Excluded. Support hours are a direct labor proxy only; fixed engineering/sales/legal/security work is not priced.

formulas.allowable_cac_break_even_before_fixed_co: contribution_after_variable_labor; spending this entire amount yields £0 toward fixed costs/profit, so working CAC target should be lower
formulas.vat_registered_contribution: (1 - refund_rate) * checkout_price / (1 + VAT_rate) - (1 + replacement_rate) * fulfilment_cost / (1 + VAT_rate) - payment_fee
formulas.discounted_contribution: apply discount to all-in checkout price; fulfillment unchanged; refund reserve uses discounted checkout price; same payment fee percentage/fixed model
formulas.expected_creator_commission_per_initial_: (1 - refund_rate) * creator_commission_per_retained_order; subtract from expected contribution per initial order
formulas.saas_month_operating_scenario: paid_accounts*(price/(1+VAT)-gateway fee-Stripe Billing fee-paid support-account API cost) - free_accounts*(free support-account API cost) - monthly fixed infra

physical_scenarios.status: Supplier product and shipping inputs observed in public catalogue/schedule; price and all reserve/labor values are hypotheses.
Supplier product, optional tee label and shipping inputs observed; price, label choice and reserve/labor values are hypotheses.
Catalogue inputs observed; £30 delivered offer, 8% refund/2% replacement and labor are hypotheses.

sensitivity_examples.shipping_charge_included_in_price: Because £72/£45/£30 are already modeled as the whole customer-paid amount, adding a separate postage charge is double-counting revenue. Free delivery must be funded inside the stated price or raise it.
sensitivity_examples.affiliate_vs_paid_cac: At 10% commission paid only on non-refunded orders, commission per retained order is £6.81 crew / £4.11 tee / £2.60 tote. At the assumed 8% refunds, expected commission per initial acquired order is £6.26 / £3.78 / £2.40. Compare CAC and contribution on the same denominator; include gifted stock/postage separately.
sensitivity_examples.creator_content_rights: No observed licence rate. Any content reuse fee is an explicit fixed acquisition cost. Add cash fee plus gifted units/postage to CAC; do not imply permission or sales attribution.

cash_timing.supplier: Inkthreadable publishes 3-5 working days before dispatch; payment is due when the POD fulfilment order is placed (account terms/individual order must be checked).
cash_timing.processor: Shopify Payments UK published minimum settlement is 3 business days; bank transfer may take another 1-3 business days. Friday-Sunday capture batches; configured schedule, holidays, verification/risk review and bank timing can extend availability.
cash_timing.refunds: Refund reduces next available payout; UK refunds can be debited from linked bank account outside regular payout schedule. A negative balance may delay payouts. Hold a separate refund/replacement float, not merely an accounting reserve.
cash_timing.cash_rule: Do not use the full paid order amount as spendable cash before fulfillment, expected refunds and provider fees have been funded. This model has no sale history to calibrate a float.

saas_scenario.definition_note: Gross margin proxy subtracts model API usage, Stripe Payments fee and Stripe Billing 0.7% fee; it excludes the £50 shared infrastructure allowance. After support, paid contribution is £31.97/£40.83 ex-VAT revenue (78.3%) before fixed infrastructure and free-tier subsidy. At the fixed 100 free/10 paid mix, the partial monthly operating surplus is £135.65 after modeled payment and billing fees, API use, support proxy, and £50 infra/tools; it excludes founder development/sales/admin, overages, security/legal, failed payments/refunds/chargebacks and profit taxes. It is not net profit or a forecast.
saas_scenario.free_tier_guardrail: A 5-minute human-support allowance costs £1.25/account/month at £15/hour, about 14x the modeled £0.09 text API workload. At the fixed 100-free-user scenario plus £50 shared fixed infrastructure, six paid accounts at modeled contribution cover those costs. If free accounts grow in a 10-free-to-1-paid ratio, three paid accounts cover that ratio plus £50 fixed infrastructure. Restrict free tier to self-serve/asynchronous support or cap free-account count until actual ticket time supports it.
saas_scenario.paid_support_guardrail: 30 support minutes per £49 account/month costs £7.50 and is material. Track minutes, usage and renewal retention; set included support boundaries before promising service levels.
saas_scenario.VAT_registered_vs_unregistered_note: The VAT-registered case reduces £49 customer receipt to £40.83 service revenue. A nonregistered case cannot divide receipts by 1.2 or reclaim eligible input VAT. Mandatory registration rules apply at >£90,000 rolling taxable turnover or expectation to exceed in next 30 days; voluntary registration may be chosen below threshold. SaaS tax place-of-supply/customer status can change cross-border outcomes; model only domestic UK assumptions here.
saas_scenario.limitations: No measured usage, user support rate, retention, conversion, churn, paid/free mix, infrastructure quote, application security/compliance cost or sales cost. Do not derive an LTV/CAC ratio; no lifetime value evidence exists.

sources.facts: Changer 2.0 £31.53 incl VAT and Freestyler £19.69 incl VAT, each with first decoration in prior live review; verify exact variant and selected artwork at order.
One decoration location included; extra location £5.04 incl VAT and optional tee printed label £1.51 incl VAT in prior live review.
Current published UK Royal Mail 48: 0-100g £2.88, 101-699g £3.78; product weights list T-shirts 100g, sweatshirts 200g, tote bags 100g. Page updated 4 Mar 2026.
Stanley/Stella Tote Bag, woven 300gsm, listed £11.13 incl VAT, embroidery available.
Basic online standard cards 2% + 25p; £25 monthly or £19/mo billed yearly. Confirm selected plan/billing.
UK minimum settlement 3 business days; bank transfer generally 1-3 additional business days; timing can vary.
Refunds deduct from payout; UK refund debit can come from linked bank account; bank receipt can take up to 10 business days for customers.
Distance-sale cancellation rights apply; standard delivery refund is due. Financial reserve is an analyst scenario, not a substitute for legal duties.
Mandatory registration when taxable turnover exceeds £90,000 over previous 12 months or expected over £90,000 next 30 days; voluntary registration below threshold possible.
Standard VAT rate 20%; most goods and services.
Input VAT recovery is subject to eligibility and valid records/invoices.
Stripe standard UK cards 1.5% + 20p; used for SaaS subscription example, not stacked on Shopify.
GPT-5.6 Luna text token rate £ not stated: USD $0.20/M input and $1.20/M output; API workload is illustration, not the product's chosen/verified model.
Pay-as-you-go Billing price 0.7% of Billing volume, including Billing transactions on/off Stripe and excluding one-off invoices.

monthly_physical_example.status: Illustration only: 10 orders of one SKU, £8 CAC per order, modeled variable labor/refund reserve, £25 monthly store fee; excludes fixed setup labor, other overhead and profit taxes. Not a profit forecast.
